user.title: Birthdays
user.description: Set up the birthday manager. Afterwards open **Birthdays** in the sidebar to add people, choose notifications and edit the message texts.

add_person.name: Add person
add_person.description: Adds a person to the birthday list.

last_name.name: Last name
last_name.description: Last name (needed for the formal salutation).

birthdate.name: Birth date
birthdate.description: Date of birth. The year is ignored if it is unknown.

year_known.name: Year known
year_known.description: Turn off if the year of birth is unknown (no age is shown).

salutation.name: Salutation
salutation.description: Used to choose the right greeting.

style.name: Style
style.description: Personal (Dear Max) or formal (Dear Mr. Smith).

greeting_enabled.name: Send greeting automatically
greeting_enabled.description: Send the congratulation automatically on the birthday.

greeting_notify.name: Notify target
greeting_notify.description: Notify service or entity for the congratulation, e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone.

update_person.name: Update person
update_person.description: Changes an existing person. Only the given fields are changed.

person.name: Person
person.description: Full name or ID of the person.

year_known.name: Year known
year_known.description: Whether the year of birth is known.

salutation.name: Salutation
salutation.description: Used to choose the right greeting.

greeting_notify.name: Notify target
greeting_notify.description: Notify service or entity for the congratulation.

remove_person.name: Remove person
remove_person.description: Deletes a person from the list.

person.name: Person
person.description: Full name or ID of the person.

send_greeting.name: Send greeting
send_greeting.description: Sends a congratulation now. Without a message a random text is used.

person.name: Person
person.description: Full name or ID of the person.

message.name: Message
message.description: Own text. Placeholders in curly braces (see README) are replaced. Leave empty to use a random text from the list.

get_upcoming.name: Get upcoming birthdays
get_upcoming.description: Returns the birthdays within the next days (response data).

days.name: Days
days.description: How many days to look ahead.
